visual_acceptance: Stone Architecture Kit v1 must yield eight independent reusable aged-stone Valoria families from one generated sheet: low straight wall, high straight wall, exterior corner wall, interior corner wall, stone arch opening, square pillar/buttress, parapet/cap/merlon, and rock-to-wall transition. PASS requires real separability, readable silhouettes at official 19/12/9 cameras, clean side/rear geometry, usable UV/materials, sensible pivots/orientation, no fused pieces that prevent modular reuse, and no blocking geometry that defeats streets/entrances when used as architecture. Technical PASS alone is insufficient.
